title: Tests never write to runtime-data
description: Found as F-35. runtime-data/genesis/historical-correlation holds 54 folders (442 MB), 30 of them from the last five days, and runtime-data/genesis/replays grew on the same days. Cause found: in PRODUCTION_ADMISSION, runGovernedGenesisReplay (GenesisReplayOrchestrator.ts, about line 524) saves the correlation through new FileGenesisHistoricalCorrelationPersistenceStore() with no root, so it writes to the real runtime-data even when the caller injected a temporary persistenceStore. Knowledge storage already isolates tests (resolveKnowledgeStorageRoot, isolatedTestStorageRoot); runtime-data/test-knowledge (7.5 MB) is left over from before that and stopped growing on 2026-09-01.
objective: Running any Runtime test suite leaves runtime-data unchanged, and the test run fails if it does not.
risks: The designated Day-0 replay (runtime-replay-designation.json) and its correlation are real records; they must survive any cleanup.
Deleting test leftovers from runtime-data needs the owner's separate approval, listed folder by folder.
Changing default storage roots must not move where the running Runtime reads or writes.
